3.name: Home No More
3.overview: A year after life-changing events, Ravi returns to RK Hospitals only to find everything has changed. Everyone has moved on, but the old bonds are still put to the test.

3.name: Starting Over
3.overview: An unexpected visitor lands at Vijay and Reena's home in Bangalore, causing stress. Back home, a medical emergency triggers conflict between the management and senior doctors.

3.name: No Room for Fear
3.overview: As Dr. Aradhana takes on a chaotic case, her past reveals her fearless spirit. The arrival of new doctors creates fresh dynamics. Reena worries about her abilities.

3.name: Old Scars
3.overview: A sudden health crisis leaves Reena confronting an emotional trauma. Arjun and Reena struggle to move on as old memories and unresolved emotions cast a shadow over their lives.

3.name: Unexpected Connections
3.overview: As Vijay settles into a new routine, an unexpected neighbour begins to change the atmosphere at home. A critical case at RK Hospital pushes the doctors towards a difficult option.

3.name: A Difficult Choice
3.overview: The RK Hospital doctors are forced to confront an impossible decision that tests their values. Elsewhere, Reena fights to prove herself as pressure mounts around an important case.

3.name: Standing Together
3.overview: The aftermath of a risky decision brings unexpected results for RK Hospital doctors. In Bangalore, Reena takes on a challenge, while personal relationships move in new directions.

3.name: New Possibilities
3.overview: An evening out brings unexpected conversations and emotional moments. Meanwhile, unresolved feelings leave several lives standing at an important crossroads.

3.name: Silent Suspicions
3.overview: Reena struggles to move past disturbing memories of the people she left behind. At RK Hospital, growing concerns over unexplained medical cases demand urgent attention.

3.name: Growing Bonds
3.overview: Divi lashes out over the stolen money, revealing her pent-up emotions. Reena suspects a young patient's injuries have a deeper cause, while Aradhana faces haunting flashbacks.

3.name: Hidden Wounds
3.overview: Reena puts on an act to expose the man who misbehaved with Krithika. Meanwhile, something Reena says leaves her father upset, while she agrees to invite Kathir home for dinner.

3.name: False Trails
3.overview: The banned drug investigation at RK Hospital raises new questions. While Reena's growing relationship with Kathir offers new hope, hidden truths remain concealed.

3.name: Unspoken Doubts
3.overview: Reena gets restless after an unexpected call from Arjun. At RK Hospital, the doctors search for answers over suspicious drug procurement. Meanwhile. Arjun and Madhu get closer.

3.name: Unfinished Feelings
3.overview: Reena struggles to deal with memories of Arjun and the past. At RK Hospital, the doctors face a difficult choice. Divi quietly makes a decision that could change everything.

3.name: Vanishing Lines
3.overview: At RK Hospital, search for the person behind the suspicious medicine continues. Sindhu and Rocky’s relationship faces a setback. Divi’s disappearance leaves her family in shock.

3.name: A Sudden Shock
3.overview: Divi’s absence brings her family together. Radhi is set to face the challenges ahead. Rocky and Sindhu visit Reena. Fresh doubts at RK Hospital point toward an unexpected lead.

3.name: Buried Questions
3.overview: Sid's recovery brings relief to Radhi and her family, while Amala's doubts about Kanniyappan's past deepen. Meanwhile, Arjun is forced to face old relationships and choices.

3.name: Breaking Point
3.overview: As the hospital battles financial strain, Radhi steps in to guide Manasa. Reena helps Kiran seek employment while Madhu's troubles push Arjun to act.

3.name: Dangerous Choices
3.overview: Arjun's medical future is at risk after a final warning, while RK Hospital tackles a high-risk triplet pregnancy. Meanwhile, an unexpected moment brings Arjun and Madhu closer.

3.name: Hidden Truths
3.overview: Arjun struggles with his feelings for Madhu, while Amala learns the truth about Kanniyappan. Reena's health sparks new questions as buried secrets from her past resurface.

3.name: Unspoken Questions
3.overview: Reena faces health concerns as Vijay grows increasingly worried. At the same time, Anu questions Vijay's decisions, forcing him to confront the choices he made.

3.name: A Familiar Shadow
3.overview: Radhi grows uneasy when an unexpected encounter raises questions. Aradhana gets a visitor from her past, leaving her to face emotions she has long kept buried.

3.name: Old Ties
3.overview: While Aradhana struggles to deal with her father's unexpected presence, Reena begins questioning the truth behind the organ that changed her life.

3.name: Crossing Lines
3.overview: Aradhana's father's threat forces her into a corner. Just as Madhu and Arjun find themselves drawing closer, Reena sends him a text.

3.name: Hidden Identity
3.overview: Arjun finds himself caught between his growing bond with Madhu and the emotions stirred by Reena. Anu faces an unsettling encounter that threatens to expose her past.

3.name: A Risky Choice
3.overview: A difficult heart transplant case puts the RK Hospital doctors under pressure as they weigh the risks against a patient's urgent need. Aradhana faces questions about her secret.

3.name: Unwanted Truths
3.overview: Aradhana is a dilemma as Kanniyappan reveals he knows her secret. At the hospital, the heart transplant case takes an unexpected turn, leaving Raghav questioning his decision.

3.name: A Difficult Decision
3.overview: Raghav and Amala face resistance after taking a stand on a critical case. While Arjun and Madhu grow closer, an unexpected encounter with Reena threatens their equation.

3.name: Unexpected Reunion
3.overview: Reena reaches Chennai and finds herself being drawn back to memories. While Arjun makes a promise to Madhu, Divi is elated to meet Reena.

3.name: Back Again
3.overview: Reena's return brings an emotional reunion with Divi and stirs memories of the life she left behind. Vijay and Reena visit the hospital where she was operated on, with questions.

3.name: Old Questions
3.overview: Reena quizzes Rocky about Radhi and Divi after their unexpected visit. As she recalls the past, old emotions resurface and leave Rocky thinking what she may be trying to uncover.

3.name: Hidden Evidence
3.overview: A routine check of the hospital ambulance leaves Kanniyappan scared while Aradhana's actions raise doubts about what she may be trying to hide. Reena finally meets Arjun in a café.

3.name: Growing Doubts
3.overview: Reena insists she is unaffected at the sight of Arjun moving on. At RK Hospital, Raghav notices inconsistencies in a patient's records and begins questioning Aradhana's actions.

3.name: Unanswered Questions
3.overview: Vijay's involvement in a critical case trouble Raghav. Growing increasingly suspicious about Aradhana's actions, Raghav confronts her.

3.name: A Dangerous Secret
3.overview: Rocky requests Arjun for help with a sensitive case. Vijay is adamant in his stand. An anxious Aradhana discharges her father from the hospital, only to fall into a bigger trap.

3.name: A Face from the Past
3.overview: Vijay and Reena’s return to RK Hospital brings back painful memories. A critical medical case gets old connections into focus and sets the stage for an unexpected encounter.

3.name: Old Connections
3.overview: Vijay and Aradhana reconnect after years apart. Meanwhile, Arjun's exam scores drop, and Vijay pressures him to reveal the truth to Reena.

3.name: A Painful Truth
3.overview: Reena finally knows who her donor is, which devastates her. At the hospital, she meets Rocky to show him Radhi's medical reports that raise questions she cannot easily ignore.

3.name: A Growing Concern
3.overview: Aradhana becomes wary of Raghav reporting her father's false hospitalisation. As Reena and Vijay get ready to leave for Bengaluru, she presents Radhi's medical report to him.

3.name: A Sudden Crisis
3.overview: Reena worries about Radhi's health and plans to get a second blood test out of her mother. When that fails, she confronts Radhi about her health that escalates into an emergency.

3.name: Two Months!
3.overview: Radhi agrees to consider a medical test but places an unexpected condition on Reena. While Reena struggles with the decision, Manasa encounters a new problem.

3.name: The Return
3.overview: Pressure builds as Vijay is urged to return to Bangalore hospital. Meanwhile, Reena tries to protect Radhi and deal with the growing tension around her health.

3.name: Critical Hours
3.overview: A routine hospital visit takes a turn when Sharmi’s condition demands immediate attention. While her husband tries to accept the situation, Rocky makes a crucial medical decision.

3.name: Old Memories
3.overview: Aradhana and Vijay revisit memories from their medical college days, recalling the difficult path that shaped their lives. And an old connection begins to take on new meaning.

3.name: Hidden Presence
3.overview: Manasa resigns from the CEO’s post. Reena moves in with Radhi and her family. However, the pressure of hiding the truth of her whereabouts from Vijay becomes difficult.

3.name: Complicated Feelings
3.overview: Radhi, Reena and Divi share unexpected moments of happiness as their bond grows stronger. Meanwhile, Vijay informs Anu about Ammu and struggles to handle the complicated situation.

3.name: The Missing Link
3.overview: Raghav and his team uncover a possible connection between Kanniyappan and a past hospital tragedy. Radhi faces an unexpected health concern that forces Reena to confront her fears.

3.name: Growing Suspicion
3.overview: Rocky grows increasingly doubtful of Kanniyappan as the team is set to protect Radhi and her family. Later, Kanniyappan’s shocking step stuns Radhi, Reena and the hospital staff.

3.name: Under Pressure
3.overview: A powerful judge turns his anger towards RK Hospital. As Radhi and Reena face a difficult medical situation, Arjun moves closer to reclaiming RK Hospital.

3.name: A Price to Pay
3.overview: The judge holds RK Hospital accountable for his traumatic experience, putting Ashok under pressure. Meanwhile, Aradhana’s hopes regarding Vijay take an unexpected turn.

3.name: A Family in Fear
3.overview: Radhi’s diagnosis leaves her family shattered, while Reena searches for ways to support her mother. Elsewhere, Arjun finds himself caught in an unexpected situation.

3.name: A Costly Offer
3.overview: Ashok makes Arjun an unexpected offer concerning RK Hospital. As Vijay considers a new chapter in Chennai, Reena faces the challenge of keeping her relationships from colliding.

3.name: An Unexpected Arrival
3.overview: Vijay’s sudden return to Chennai catches Reena off guard, forcing her to reconsider her secrets about Radhi. Meanwhile, Arjun’s personal life grows complicated.

3.name: A Dangerous Guest
3.overview: Ayyappan’s intimidating arrival at Raghav’s home raises unsettling questions. While tensions continue within RK Hospital, Aradhana confesses to Radhi about her feelings for Vijay.

3.name: Behind Closed Doors
3.overview: Vijay examines RK Hospital’s records and prepares for his new responsibilities. Reena tries to adjust to the changes around her while Shyamala’s case adds to the uncertainty.

3.name: Unanswered Questions
3.overview: Vijay turns to Anu to clarify a memory from the past, unaware of the complications. At RK Hospital, Arjun and Vijay navigate their evolving professional relationship.
